decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir is close to the firm's core hydraulic steelwork business, fits its municipal customers, and the expanding firm has the slack to carry it while results are still uncertain.

The energy management system for water facilities matches the firm's stated strategy of digital networking and energy recovery, so it is likely to meet aspirations, although its listing as a mere mention echoes the fouling-detection products the firm already dropped.
The overflow flap gate line has several models and its own web page, shows clear commitment and close fit with the established offer, and faces no shortfall that would prompt search for alternatives.
